en: Ecclesiastes 5

p.src: 1  Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

ja: のようにいけにえをささげるより、
たちが悪を行っていることさえ
en: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.
u.src: 1  Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

zh: 5:1 或譯：勝過獻愚昧人的祭

p.src: 2  Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

ja: いてはならない。神の前で何かを口にしようと、
en: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
u.src: 2  Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

p.src: 3  For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

en: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
u.src: 3  For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

p.src: 4  When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

en: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.
u.src: 4  When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

p.src: 5  It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

en: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.
u.src: 5  It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

p.src: 6  Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

ja: によって罪に陥ってはならない。
で、「これは間違いでした」と
ってはならない。なぜあなたの言葉で神を
en: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?
u.src: 6  Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

p.src: 7  For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

ja: には空しさがある。だが、あなたは
en: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.
u.src: 7  For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

p.src: 8  If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

ja: が踏みにじられているのを
に見張られており、その
官たちがいるからである。
en: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.
u.src: 8  If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

p.src: 9  Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

ja: の産物はすべての者の益となり、
en: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.
u.src: 9  Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

p.src: 10  He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

en: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.
u.src: 10  He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

p.src: 11  When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

ja: える。その所有者にとって、それを目で眺めて楽しむこと以外に
en: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?
u.src: 11  When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

p.src: 12  The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

ja: くても心地よい。しかし、
en: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.
u.src: 12  The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

p.src: 13  There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

en: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.
u.src: 13  There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

p.src: 14  Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

en: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.
u.src: 14  Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

p.src: 15  As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

en: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.
u.src: 15  As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

p.src: 16  This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

ja: である。人は来たときと全く同じように去って行く。
en: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?
u.src: 16  This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

p.src: 17  All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

ja: べ、大いにいらだち、病み、
en: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.
u.src: 17  All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

p.src: 18  Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

ja: よ、私が良い、またふさわしいと
、人が日の下で重ねるすべての労苦のうちに、
いものを味わうことである。これがその
en: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.
u.src: 18  Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

p.src: 19  Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

ja: ぶ力を与えたすべての
en: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.
u.src: 19  Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

p.src: 20  For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

ja: びで満たすからである。
en: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.
u.src: 20  For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.
